card.name: The letter B starting a split word
card.fires_on: The lone letter B at the start of a word that is split up, such as Bypass after Coronary Artery, Bile after with, or BASED after WEIGHT-.

modes.label: Coronary Artery Bypass
modes.description: B begins Bypass in the phrase Coronary Artery Bypass Graft.
modes.example: Status Post Coronary Artery<< B>>ypass Graft (CABG)

modes.label: WEIGHT-BASED
modes.description: B begins BASED in the capitalized phrase WEIGHT-BASED dosing.

modes.label: Bile acid
modes.description: B begins Bile in Bile Acid Sequestrants.
modes.example: Coadministration with<< B>>ile Acid Sequestrants: Admin

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens are mixed and do not fit the contexts.
card.plain: It fires on a single B that starts a word the text has broken into pieces, like Bypass or BASED.
